authoring.note: De Clercqstraat 22-2 (north side, Nassaukade end), 1898-1901. Shop street: uniform uppers, a different shop on every ground floor. 3 types: E (dark brick, corbel cornice; 7 modules in 4 pands, crowns none/tower/step), F (stucco cornice + mansard; 3 pands), and the Nassaukade corner 116526 as its own type. 153066 (crenellated corner block) keeps its own design. Multi-module pands (16-18 = 3 modules, 8-10 = 2) are one front per module with its own shop. Shops read on the 2021-03-24 strip (zoom crops) and checked against OSM/BAG; illegible lettering is left out, never invented. Pass 2 after the strip sheet: tower rises from the photo (height gate), wall colours toward the measured wall medians (model read too saturated/dark).

types.description: 1901 row 18-8: dark brown brick, 3 axes x 3 upper storeys, segmental-arched windows with stone keystone blocks, centre console balcony stack, brick corbel-table cornice; crowns: none, a square brick tower-dormer over the centre axis, or a stepped gable over the centre axis; every ground floor its own shop

tower.note: square brick tower-dormer with a two-light window rising one storey over the centre axis (16-18 middle and right, 14); top at strip row ~169-177 = 1.5-1.8 m over the parapet line -> rise 0.55 (3DBAG roof max 16.1 m; rise 1 overshot it by 1.6 m, height gate)

arched-tower.note: 12: the tower ends in a round arch over an arched light (modelled flat-topped); top at strip row ~164 = 2.0 m over the parapet -> rise 0.65

step-gable.note: 8-10: a stepped gable with one two-light attic window over the centre axis of each module; gable top at strip row 152, 2.1 m over the parapet line (row 235) -> crownRise 0.75; photo reader: trapgevel, 3 steps/side, span ~0.2-0.71 -> crownSteps 3
